children: Affirm Holdings, Inc. Class A (NASDAQ:AFRM) expects GMV to surpass $64B by fiscal 2027 with operating margin above 14.5% and raised Q1 guidance, while rolling out AI-driven underwriting and a mid-cycle product update to boost approvals as shares rally on the news.
: AFRM forecasts fiscal 2027 GMV > $64B (vs ~$49.4B in FY26), operating margin > 14.5%, adjusted operating margin > 30.5%. Q1 revenue guidance $1.19B–$1.22B on GMV $13.7B–$14.0B.

: AFRM rolled out a mid-cycle product update to boost underwriting and approval rates. Management says a bigger catalyst needs sustained GMV growth plus stable or improved loss rates in upcoming KPIs.
: AFRM launched an AI underwriting tool analyzing credit signals and borrower notes (e.g., address-change late payments). CEO Max Levchin says it augments underwriters; humans keep final approval.
: AFRM rose ~0.4% overnight and ~1.3% after an AI underwriting model announcement; shares are up over 60% in the past six months.
